name: Thaddeus Keithley
original_name: サディアス＝キースリー
source:
"Kukuku... You should be lamenting your bad luck that you met me!"

A cruel and crafty evil pirate, he has a large bounty on his head.
He never lets any of his opponents surrender and it's said the only way to get away is to ditch your boat.
